scene: The breakdancer bot bleeps happily and projects three neon exit transit routes.
picture: Along a flat rooftop edge, the silver-haired boy in a mint-green hoodie stands centre-left facing the cheering chrome robot. On the far left, a glowing pink moving walkway opens toward Starlight Arcade. Up high centre, a glass karaoke lift waits. On the far right, a docked river hover ferry floats beside the roof edge.
shown: a humming pink moving walkway entrance with an arcade sign on the left
a docked floating hover ferry glowing blue on the far right
a round glass elevator lit up with musical notes up high centre
